newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan banks cut interest rates on some loans.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan banks cut interest rates on some loans.

text.p: Morocco's commercial banks have cut interest rates to nine percent from 11 percent on investment loans to small and medium-sized firms, a bank source said on Monday.
The bank association said on Sunday the decision had been taken late last week and would apply to loans taken out from March 1 to December 31.
The move aimed "to contribute significantly to the country's economic relaunch", the association said.
Last month the association, Professional Groupement des Banques, said it was cutting by one point the rates on long-term investment loans from March 1.
It said then that the move was "a promotional campaign to encourage investment."
King Hassan urged banks in his throne speech on March 3 to cut interest rates on loans, particularly to small and medium-sized firms.
